sections.title: A Multidisciplinary Approach to Infrastructure
sections.body: Building a 1MW data center in Kenya requires more than just technical knowledge; it requires a deep understanding of local logistics, regulatory frameworks, and global capital markets. Our team is composed of professionals who have operated in over 50 countries, bringing a wealth of experience in managing large-scale CAPEX projects. From data center architects who specialize in modular cooling systems to financial strategists with deep roots in the East African market, we have assembled the talent necessary to ensure 99.9% uptime and 35-50% EBITDA margins. We pride ourselves on engineering honesty and radical transparency, ensuring that every phase of the project is executed with precision and accountability. Additional context: the project follows a clear rollout roadmap that aligns low-cost energy, infrastructure reliability, and flexible deployment models.
